text:
sarah: Heads-up — we've seen a spike in prefix-cache evictions in prod over the last ~6h, hit-rate dropped ~78% -> ~61%. Alert fired twice. Anyone owning the alert/dashboards? Links pls.

ben: pinging @jun and @mira who own prefix cache dashboards? also what alert is this exactly? :eyes:

jun: i'm the dashboard owner for prefix-cache panels. which alert name did you see?

mira: +1, i'm co-owner. want the panel links and the alert id to triage. :+1:

sarah: exact alert id: `prod.kv.prefix.evictions.alert` — fired at 04:12 and 08:03. grafana i opened: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/prefix-cache/prefix-metrics?panelId=4 but that's the older view.

mira: can you paste a short log snippet and any related trace ids? helps decide if it's noise or real memory pressure.

sarah: panel (newer): https://grafana.redwood.com/d/xyz/prefix-ops?panelId=11
log snippet (redacted):
```
[2026-03-16T03:59:01Z] prefix="usr/" evicted_keys=1245 evict_reason="memory_pressure" pool=gpuprod-3
[2026-03-16T07:58:59Z] prefix="usr/" evicted_keys=2102 evict_reason="backend_timeout" pool=gpuprod-4
```
Also saw a spike in 5xxs from the runtime around 07:58.

ben: @mira any quick tuning suggestions? threshold too low or noisy? :thinking:

mira: a few immediate ideas: 1) alert uses 5m avg today — bump to 15m to reduce transient noise; 2) check pool-level memory caps, we sometimes evict aggressively on bursty seq lengths; 3) add a separate alert for evict_reason=backend_timeout so ops can triage backend regressions.

jun: agree. i'll add a per-model kv-size distribution panel + hotkey counts to help spot single-prefix storms. will open a PR to dashboard repo.

katie: cc @oncall (opsbot) — can we route these eviction alerts to a dedicated cache channel instead of eng-platform? eng-platform is noisy.

opsbot: noted — planning route update: `prod_evictions -> #platform-caches` with duplicate suppression 30m. will confirm when applied.

sarah: perfect. @jun can you tag the PR and add a follow-up to run sampling queries in QA to validate?

jun: yes. PR: https://git.redwood.com/dashboards/prefix-cache/pull/142 — ETA EOD PST. i'll include the sampling queries.

mira: for the tuned alert i propose: eviction_rate > 0.8% over 15m AND hit_rate drop > 10% over 15m. i'll draft the rule and post a PR to alerting after jun's dashboard changes.

ben: sounds good. once routing is in place and owners set i'll close the noisy pages. thanks all :+1:

sarah: thanks — i'll follow up if we see further evictions after the changes.
